# v1.4.0 - Smart quest buttons and a queue you can see

### What's Changed

Questcord got a cleaner face: the separate **Auto Complete** and **+ Queue** buttons are now one smart button per quest tile, a new **Queue (N)** button above the quest list opens the queue panel, and the plugin settings are grouped into proper sections. Queue handling is quiet now, quests no longer have to be accepted before you queue them, and the sources ship with an AGPL-3.0 header and short hints instead of long comment blocks.

- **One smart button per quest**: the label adapts to the state (`Auto Complete`, `Add to queue`, `Queued`, `Cancel` while running and `Start quest first` for quests that are not accepted yet); two buttons per tile, stacked with Discord's own button above ours
- **Queue anything**: not-yet-accepted quests can be queued too, the queue accepts them itself when it starts them
- **Visible queue**: the new "Queue (N)" button in the quest filter row opens a panel with the enable switch, the priority picker (Videos first / Games first), the sorted queue with per-entry status and remove, and Clear Queue; the button only shows up while the queue has entries
- **Quieter notifications**: queue toggling no longer fires "Queue added / removed / Now running" toasts (the button label and the header count already show the state), and the notification options are back at the top of the plugin settings
- **Reorganized settings**: Queue, Notifications, Automation, Pill position / colors / appearance and Reset are now titled sections; only the advanced debug and update options stay in Vencord's generic settings block
- **React patches instead of DOM injection**: buttons are injected through Vencord patches now (fixes layout and duplication glitches), plus a right-click "Add to queue" / "Remove from queue" entry on quest entries; labels are English by default and adapt to the Discord client language (German included)
- **Sturdier runs**: a stall watchdog restarts a stuck quest once, the activity heartbeat pace is configurable, duplicate notifications are suppressed, and the progress pills follow Discord's own tile progress
- **Tidier sources**: AGPL-3.0 headers and short lowercase hints instead of long comment blocks, no behaviour change
- Dependency updates: the grouped dev-dependency update plus the TypeScript cap at 6.x, and Dependabot now bundles updates into a single pull request

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zpt0/Questcord/compare/v1.3.1...v1.4.0
